articles.title: Housing and migration shape Spanish election as far right eyes power
articles.description: Spain votes on Sunday in a snap general election that could end Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's eight years in power and bring down one of the European Union's last remaining centre-left governments. Opinion polls favour the conservative People's Party (PP), which would likely need the support of the far-right Vox party to govern. A coalition between the two would bring the far right into national government for the first time since the death of dictator Francisco Franco in 1975.
